title: First instruments: cello at seven, a bass from his brother
summary: Foster started on a cello standing on a box, then his brother bought him a string bass; no mandolin or guitar first.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Yeah. Yeah. When did you start in music, then? Up in the ...?
You see, I'll go back as far as I can.

My sister was very little. Well, Pops, you had it here from seven years old. Yeah, but I think it was a little before that. Because my sister was very small and we were playing manor and I couldn't even reach the cello. I'd stand on the box.
To reach the cello. You played like a bass to pick the cello. Yeah. Played like a bass to pick the cello.

Yeah. Played like, see, with the bow. With the bow and all that. Yeah. And then my brother bought me a bass. Bought me a string bass around. It was in the 19th. So I'm around 19. And you started out another instrument first? A mandolin or anything else?
